products.name: FitBulls Bouncer Dumbbell
products.shortDesc: Unisex vinyl-coated cast iron — ideal for home and gym workouts
products.description: A pair of unisex vinyl dumbbells ideal for women and beginners. Superior quality cast iron topped with a smooth vinyl coating provides an anti-slip grip and prevents damage to the floor. Ergonomic and compact design makes it great for home workouts.

products.name: FitBulls Hexagon Rubber Dumbbell
products.shortDesc: Hex design prevents rolling — rubber coated, commercial grade
products.description: The Hex Dumbbells are a durable and versatile free weights solution. Their unique hexagonal design prevents rolling, while the rubber coating protects flooring and reduces noise, making them reliable for any gym or training space.

products.name: MS Powder Coated Dumbbell
products.shortDesc: Mild steel powder coated — long-lasting industrial finish
products.description: Mild steel construction with a durable powder coat finish provides resistance to rust and chipping, ensuring long service life in commercial environments.

products.name: FitBulls Chrome Dumbbell
products.shortDesc: Sleek chrome finish — perfect for studio and luxury gyms
products.description: Chrome dumbbells offer a sleek, compact design ideal for home environments and premium fitness studios. Chrome plated finish is both attractive and durable.

products.name: FitBulls Arc Dumbbell
products.shortDesc: Curved arc design — ergonomic grip, modern aesthetic
products.description: FitBulls Arc Dumbbells combine a distinctive curved design with functional ergonomics. The arc shape allows a more natural wrist position, reducing strain during high-rep sets.

products.name: 7 Hole Weight Lifting Plate
products.shortDesc: Classic 7-hole rubber-coated plate — Olympic compatible
products.description: A 7 Hole Weight Lifting Plate used in combination with barbells or dumbbells. Rubber-coated construction protects flooring and reduces noise. Compatible with all standard 50mm Olympic barbells.

products.name: Captain America TPR Plates
products.shortDesc: TPR-coated decorative plates — premium look for modern gyms
products.description: Fitbulls TPR Coated Captain America Plates feature a distinctive shield-inspired design with premium TPR coating for aesthetic appeal and durable protection.

products.name: FitBulls Bumper Plate With Hub
products.shortDesc: Drop-safe bumper plates — ideal for Olympic weightlifting
products.description: FitBulls Bumper Plates protect you, your barbell, and your floors during heavy lifting. Essential for Olympic lifts including snatch and clean and jerk.

products.name: FPS E6804 Pull Down
products.shortDesc: Commercial lat pull down — smooth cable, heavy gauge steel
products.description: The FPS E6804 Phantom Series Pull Down is a premium commercial lat pull-down machine built for high-volume gym use. Features a smooth high-tensile cable system and multiple grip attachment points.

specs.Attachments: Multi-grip lat bar and close grip handle

products.name: FPS 6806 Horizontal Pull
products.shortDesc: Seated cable row — targets mid and lower back
products.description: The FPS 6806 Phantom Series Horizontal Pull activates the back muscles through a horizontal pulling motion. The chest pad ensures stable and comfortable support throughout the movement.

products.name: FPS E6861 Abductor Adductor
products.shortDesc: Dual-function hip machine — abductor and adductor in one
products.description: The FPS E6861 is a dual-function hip abductor and adductor machine targeting outer and inner thigh muscles. Padded seat and back support ensure user comfort.

products.name: FRS 6704 Pull Down
products.shortDesc: Rogue Series selectorized lat pull down — commercial grade
products.description: The FRS 6704 Rogue Series Pull Down provides smooth, consistent resistance through a high-quality cable and pulley system. Built with commercial-grade steel for high-traffic gym environments.

products.name: FRS 6738 Pec Dec
products.shortDesc: Pec deck fly machine — isolated chest training
products.description: The FRS 6738 Rogue Series Pec Dec provides isolated chest fly movement. Adjustable arm pads and seat height accommodate users of all sizes.

products.name: TA 40 Rear Kick
products.shortDesc: Plate-loaded rear kick — glute and hamstring isolation
products.description: The TA 40 Rear Kick is a plate-loaded machine for isolated glute and hamstring training. Allows progressive overloading without weight stack limitations.

products.name: TA 45 Hack Squat
products.shortDesc: 45 degree hack squat — plate loaded compound leg machine
products.description: The TA 45 Hack Squat provides excellent lower body compound movement targeting quads, hamstrings and glutes at a 45-degree angle for natural biomechanical movement.

products.name: FitBulls Power Cage Rack
products.shortDesc: Heavy-duty power cage — squat, bench, pull-up all-in-one
products.description: A Power Cage functions as a mechanical spotter for free weight barbell exercises without movement restrictions. Built with heavy-gauge steel for maximum safety and longevity.

specs.Attachments: Pull-up bar J-cups safety arms dip bars

products.name: FitBulls Smith Machine
products.shortDesc: Commercial Smith machine — linear bearing guided barbell
products.description: FitBulls Smith Machine is most suitable for chest and shoulder workout in a single station. Multiple linear bearings make it easy for any height user.

products.name: FBS 902 Spin Bike
products.shortDesc: Commercial spin bike — 18kg flywheel, smooth resistance
products.description: The FBS 902 Spin Bike is a commercial-grade indoor cycling bike. Heavy 18kg flywheel delivers smooth, consistent resistance. Adjustable seat and handlebars for all riders.

products.name: Olympic Weight Lifting Rod
products.shortDesc: 7ft Olympic barbell — 50mm rotating sleeves
products.description: Premium Olympic Weight Lifting Rod manufactured in-house at Premier Rubbers. 7ft straight bar with 50mm rotating sleeves, suitable for all Olympic weight plates.

products.name: Hex Trap Bar
products.shortDesc: Hex bar for deadlifts and farmers carry — neutral grip
products.description: The Hex Trap Bar allows a person to stand inside the hexagonal frame. Reduces lower back stress compared to straight bar deadlifts. Ideal for loaded carries and shrugs.

products.name: FitBulls Synergy 360
products.shortDesc: Multi-functional 360 degree training system
products.description: FitBulls Synergy 360 is a new system for personal training combining several popular total-body dynamic exercises helping trainers effectively train individuals and groups.

products.name: FitBulls Deadlift Platform
products.shortDesc: Rubber deadlift platform — protects floor, dampens noise
products.description: FitBulls deadlift platform acts as a cushion during heavy lifts, preventing weight damage and dampening noise. Available in 50mm and 25mm thickness.

specs.Function: Weight drop protection and noise dampening

products.name: Leg Curl Extension Machine
products.shortDesc: Dual function leg curl and extension — smooth selectorized
products.description: FitBulls Leg Curl Extension Machine provides dual functionality — seated leg extension and prone leg curl in one compact machine with a smooth selectorized weight stack.

testimonials.name: Rajesh Kumar
testimonials.review: We outfitted our entire gym with FitBulls Phantom Series machines and Bouncer Dumbbells. Build quality is commercial-grade — zero issues after a year of heavy daily use across 40 plus members. Premier Rubbers is now our only supplier.

testimonials.name: Sandeep Patil
testimonials.review: Set up a complete home gym with FitBulls weight plates and a power rack. The powder coating is flawless and the welds are immaculate. Ordered directly from their Meerut facility — fast turnaround and great pricing.

testimonials.name: Vikram Singh
testimonials.review: As a distributor, I have worked with several manufacturers. Premier Rubbers stands out for consistent quality control and reliable bulk order fulfillment. Their FitBulls dumbbell range moves fast with our retail clients.

testimonials.name: Priya Agarwal
testimonials.review: The Hexagon Rubber Dumbbells are a hit with my clients — no rolling, no floor damage, and the grip stays solid even with sweaty hands. Ordered a full rack-mounted set and could not be happier.

testimonials.name: Arjun Mehta
testimonials.review: The Rogue Series machines from FitBulls are exceptional value. We run 6 classes a day and the equipment shows no wear after 8 months. The after-sales support from Mr. Samyak Jain is responsive and genuine.
